quarantine=$base/quarantine

if ! mkdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "replay: another recovery is already running" >&2
    exit 1
fi

    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$index"

{
    source_file=$1
    reason=$2
    source_name=$(basename -- "$source_file")
    quarantine_file=$quarantine/$source_name
    n=1

    while [ -e "$quarantine_file" ] && ! cmp -s "$source_file" "$quarantine_file"; do
        quarantine_file=$quarantine/$source_name.$n
        n=$((n + 1))
    done
    if [ ! -e "$quarantine_file" ]; then
        quarantine_tmp=$quarantine_file.tmp.$$
        cp -p "$source_file" "$quarantine_tmp"

    [ -f "$message" ] || continue

        {
            line=$0
            sub(/\r$/, "", line)
            if (tolower(line) ~ /^message-id[[:space:]]*:/) count++
